CREATE TABLE "public"."eifu_access_record" (
  "acknowledged_notice_version" text NOT NULL,
  "anonymized_at" timestamptz(3),
  "catalog_number_input" text NOT NULL,
  "client_address" bytea,
  "created_at" timestamptz(3) NOT NULL,
  "email" bytea,
  "email_lookup_hash" text,
  "email_verified" bool DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  "id" BIGSERIAL NOT NULL,
  "identity_key_id" text,
  "lot_number_input" text NOT NULL,
  "outcome" text NOT NULL,
  "request_id" text,
  "resolved_document_version_id" int8,
  "resolved_product_id" int8,
  "resolved_via_override" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "user_agent" text,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "access_record_anonymized_keeps_no_identity" CHECK (((anonymized_at IS NULL) OR ((email IS NULL) AND (client_address IS NULL) AND (email_lookup_hash IS NULL) AND (identity_key_id IS NULL)))),
  CONSTRAINT "access_record_outcome_is_known" CHECK ((outcome = ANY (ARRAY['RESOLVED'::text, 'CATALOG_NUMBER_NOT_FOUND'::text, 'LOT_NOT_FOUND'::text, 'LOT_CATALOG_MISMATCH'::text, 'LOT_DATE_CONFLICT'::text, 'NO_APPLICABLE_VERSION'::text, 'AMBIGUOUS_APPLICABILITY'::text, 'NO_FILE_FOR_VERSION'::text, 'OVERRIDE_TARGET_NOT_PUBLISHED'::text]))),
  CONSTRAINT "access_record_user_agent_length" CHECK (((user_agent IS NULL) OR (char_length(user_agent) <= 512)))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."eifu_verification" (
  "attempts_used" int4 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "catalog_number_input" text NOT NULL,
  "client_address" bytea NOT NULL,
  "code_hash" text NOT NULL,
  "created_at" timestamptz(3) NOT NULL,
  "email" bytea NOT NULL,
  "email_lookup_hash" text NOT NULL,
  "ended_at" timestamptz(3),
  "expires_at" timestamptz(3) NOT NULL,
  "id" BIGSERIAL NOT NULL,
  "identity_key_id" text NOT NULL,
  "lot_number_input" text NOT NULL,
  "notice_version" text NOT NULL,
  "public_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "send_failed_at" timestamptz(3),
  "used_at" timestamptz(3),
  "user_agent" text,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "verification_attempts_in_range" CHECK (((attempts_used >= 0) AND (attempts_used <= 5))),
  CONSTRAINT "verification_inputs_length" CHECK (((char_length(catalog_number_input) <= 256) AND (char_length(lot_number_input) <= 256))),
  CONSTRAINT "verification_user_agent_length" CHECK (((user_agent IS NULL) OR (char_length(user_agent) <= 512)))
)
